messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | Sustainability, Government Relations & Corporate Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Silvester & Company Team,

Your global mining executive-search coverage and leadership work across sustainability and responsible business are relevant to my profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, resources and energy where sustainable growth depends on credible institutional and community relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
